description: Original composed middlegame and endgame roots for Phase 3C structural performance coverage, selected before engine searches or timings.
provenance: Composed directly from original piece placements on 2026-10-16 for this project. No previous engine assets, existing games, external position collections, strength-opening suites, engine evaluations, solutions, or timing results were used to select these roots.
selection_policy: Six middlegames and six endgames, each with three White-to-move and three Black-to-move roots. Cover closed and open structures, tactical contacts, queenless play, rook/minor/pawn/mixed endgames, and all eight pinned SFNNv16 material buckets. Referee checks use chess==1.11.2 only. The suite is structural coverage, not a representative random sample or a playing-strength test.
history_limitations: These are composed six-field FEN roots with empty move histories, no castling or en-passant rights, and zero halfmove clocks. Local validity is checked; historical reachability from the initial position is not proved. Earlier repetition history is unavailable. Do not use them as replacements for full-history match qualification openings.

openings.why_selected: Full material with interlocked central pawns and restricted minor pieces; White has no immediate legal capture or checking move. Covers dense quiet feature relationships.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the closed-center coverage slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: Dense but asymmetric pawn cover with kings on opposite wings; Black has no immediate legal capture or checking move. Complements the closed-center root without reflecting its board.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the quiet asymmetric middlegame slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: An advanced central pawn attacks the f6 knight, the g5 bishop aligns that knight with the queen, and the c4 bishop contacts f7. Covers several legal captures and changing slider relationships without prescribing a solution.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the tactical minor-piece contact slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: The c-file rook faces the pawn shelter in front of the c1 king, while the b6 queen has multiple pawn contacts. Covers captures and checks in a less blocked middlegame.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the open-file pressure slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: Queenless active-piece play with the e7 knight pinned to the e8 king by the e1 rook. Both sides retain two rooks and two minor pieces; covers lower material with legal capture and checking choices.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the queenless pin slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: Blocked c- and h-file pawn pairs, two rooks and two minor pieces per side, and no immediate legal captures for Black. Covers maneuvering and potential pawn breaks after queens have left the board.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the quiet queenless slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: One rook and four pawns per side, active kings, and pawn groups on both wings. White has no immediate legal captures or checks; covers quiet rook and king transitions.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the rook-activity slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: Sparse rook endgame with an advanced a3 pawn, a seventh-rank rook, and a second-rank rook near the white king. Covers pawn captures and checking activity at low material.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the sparse rook-and-pawn slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: One knight and four pawns per side with separated pawn groups and nonadjacent active kings. White has no immediate legal capture or checking move; covers nonsliding minor-piece maneuvering.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the knight endgame slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: Opposite-colored bishops with pawns on both wings and immediate bishop-pawn contacts. Covers long diagonals, captures, and changing pawn relationships without asserting a game-theoretic result.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the bishop endgame slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: Two kings and two separated passed pawns, with no initial captures or checks. Covers the sparsest nonterminal material bucket, pawn advancement, and king movement; no winning or drawing claim is attached.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the sparse pawn endgame slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.

openings.why_selected: Rook and bishop versus rook and knight, five pawns each, central pawn contact and advanced kings. Complements pure rook and minor endings with mixed attack geometry and moderate occupancy.
openings.provenance: Original independent composition for the mixed endgame slot on 2026-10-16; no engine evaluation or timing selection.
